description: Major migration to Jest 30. Covers new test runner API, configuration changes, snapshot format updates, and module resolution changes. Affects reading-advantage and advantage-games which use Jest for unit tests.
deviation_notes: Kept active after the 2026-06-21 fleet completion audit rejected the closeout: the green gate ran only a subset of suites and un-gated suites still have real failures, including migration canaries. Full-suite or formally-quarantined evidence is required before closeout.
